newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X says confident of Busang resolution.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X says confident of Busang resolution.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd said on Wednesday it is still optimistic the outstanding disputes over its Busang deposit can be overcome.

"Given the size of the Busang gold deposit in Indonesia and the pending issuance of the COWs (contracts of work), it is no surprise that certain parties have found it opportune to advance self-interested claims," president and chief executive David Walsh said in a statement.
"Based upon the advice from our lawyers and recent discussions held in Indonesia, we remain confident that the outstanding issues can be satisfactorily resolved," he added.
Walsh said the exploration program at the Busang gold deposit continued as planned.
Bre-X repeated its intention to consider all available options to exploit the Busang deposit, including a merger or acquisition, a joint venture or the sale of a stake in the deposit.

"Bre-X has been approached by several major mining companies that have expressed an interest in entering into a transaction with Bre-X. The nature and timing of each approach varies with each company," the company said.
